Request an Appointment

Choose your service and preferred date. We will contact you to agree on your final appointment date and time. Visits are by appointment only.

Let’s arrange your visit

The form asks for your name, WhatsApp number, service and preferred date. Email is optional.

  1. Choose your service. Explore hair services or lash extensions before choosing.
  2. Save your request. A successful submission displays a thank-you message and your booking reference. Keep the reference for follow-up.
  3. Wait for confirmation. We will contact you to agree on the date and time. A saved request does not reserve or confirm an appointment.

Messaging and privacy

After saving, you can open WhatsApp to review a prepared message. Opening WhatsApp does not send it automatically: you must tap Send. You can also message us on Telegram with your booking reference.

Your contact details are used to review your request and arrange your appointment. We send booking details to our restricted staff tools, including Telegram notifications and email, to arrange your appointment. They are not sold. Campaign labels may be saved with requests for appointment reporting; optional analytics requires a separate choice.

Need help? Contact Lash & Laid.
